items.title: 〈熱門股〉川湖股價拉回修正仍獲外資承接 前3季狂賺逾23個股本
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Chuanhu’s Share Price Pulls Back Yet Still Attracted Foreign Investors, Q3 Profit Surges Over 23‑Times Equity
paras: 伺服器滑軌廠川湖(2059-TW)近期遭遇大盤拖累賣壓，20日股價持續走弱並打入跌停板5350元作收，下跌590元或9.93%，累計已連7個交易日收黑且波段跌幅達38.72%。儘管本周股價大幅修正，不過外資逆勢買超42張並寫下連2買，累計買超達299張。
其中第三季單季表現更是創下歷史新高，單季營收來到173.4億元、季增逾六成，單季毛利率攀升至88.2個百分點、營益率達82.9個百分點，單季稅後純益為117.0億元，單季每股純益高達122.79元。法人分析指出，第三季獲利爆發主要受惠於客戶新平台推出，帶動高毛利的新世代產品出貨比重提升與產品組合持續優化。
針對短期營運節奏與中長期展望，川湖第四季雖受產品世代轉換影響使營運動能暫時放緩，但法人看好2027年下半年起新平台產品放量將挹注新一波成長動能，對其長線競爭力維持正向看法，預估川湖在GB與VR以及ASIC人工智慧伺服器滑軌市場的市占率超過八成，隨著客製化獨立機櫃設計需求擴大，2026至2027年伺服器滑軌營收占比上看95%-97%。
為因應全球雲端服務供應商強勁的算力設備需求，川湖已提前啟動新一輪產能擴充計畫，美國休士頓新廠於今年9月至10月間正式啟動量產以就近服務北美客戶。同時台灣川億三期與五期廠房擴建進度也較原定規劃提前一年半至兩年，預計新增樓地板面積22萬平方公尺並使現有產能翻倍，加上川湖二廠將於明年完工加入量產，為中長期業績提供充足產能支撐。
paras_en: Server rail manufacturer Chuanhu (2059‑TW) recently faced market‑wide selling pressure, and on the 20th its share price kept weakening, hitting the daily limit down at NT$5,350, down NT$590 or 9.93%. This marks the seventh consecutive trading day of losses and a cumulative decline of 38.72% for the session. Despite the sharp correction this week, foreign investors bought 42 lots against the trend, logging a second consecutive buying day and a total net purchase of 299 lots.

In the third quarter, the company posted a record‑high single‑quarter performance: revenue reached NT$17.34 billion, up more than 60% quarter‑over‑quarter; gross margin climbed to 88.2 percentage points and operating margin hit 82.9 percentage points; net profit after tax was NT$11.70 billion, and earnings per share surged to NT$122.79. Analysts said the profit explosion was mainly driven by customers launching new platforms, which boosted shipments of high‑margin next‑generation products and continued product‑mix optimization.

Regarding short‑term operating rhythm and mid‑to‑long‑term outlook, Chuanhu’s fourth quarter may see a temporary slowdown in momentum due to a product‑generation transition. Nevertheless, analysts are optimistic that from the second half of 2027 onward, new‑platform products will scale up, injecting a fresh wave of growth. They maintain a positive view on the company’s long‑term competitiveness, estimating that Chuanhu will hold over 80% market share in the GB, VR and ASIC AI server rail markets, and that server‑rail revenue will account for 95%‑97% of total sales in 2026‑2027 as customized independent rack designs expand.

To meet the strong demand for compute equipment from global cloud service providers, Chuanhu has already launched a new round of capacity expansion. A new plant in Houston, USA, began mass production in September‑October this year to serve North American customers more closely. Meanwhile, the expansion of Taiwan’s Phase‑3 and Phase‑5 facilities has been accelerated by 1.5‑2 years, adding 220,000 square meters of floor space and doubling existing capacity. In addition, Phase‑2 will be completed next year and join mass production, providing ample capacity support for mid‑to‑long‑term earnings.

items.title: SEC執法盯上輝達會計 新加坡營收揭露方式再受檢視 輝達跌幅擴大至約13%
items.title_en: SEC Targets Nvidia Accounting, Singapore Revenue Disclosure Method Under Scrutiny, Shares Fall 13%
paras: 《路透社》20日獨家報導，知情人士透露，美國證券交易委員會(SEC)執法人員正在審查輝達(NVDA-US)的潛在會計問題，為這家醜聞纏身的晶片巨頭再添法律壓力。
《華爾街日報》週二率先報導SEC對輝達展開調查，但無法確認調查焦點；知情人士對《路透社》表示，SEC執法人員鎖定的是會計層面，這是調查方向首度曝光。
SEC發言人拒絕置評，輝達發言人未立即回應置評請求；調查不代表認定違規，此類調查許多最終未演變為執法行動。
報導刊出後，輝達股價跌幅擴大。據LSEG數據，輝達週五跌約13%，而在《路透社》刊出調查細節前，跌幅逾6%。
輝達的會計揭露方式近期已受關注。該公司去年改以客戶總部而非帳單地址劃分地區營收，稱更能反映營收地理分布，新加坡自此從地區拆分中移除。
《金融時報》週二引述公司帳目報導，這項變更之際，新加坡銷售額已飆升至輝達全球營收近半；自美國管制先進AI晶片出口中國以來，東南亞已成晶片走私轉運樞紐。
分析師與投資人也日益關切AI循環融資交易：晶片商以複雜財務安排協助客戶購置晶片、興建資料中心。批評者認為，這類安排使營收品質與真實財務曝險更難評估。
SEC執法主管David Woodcock上月對《路透社》表示，該機構正審查AI公司的企業揭露，確保發行人向投資人完整說明潛在風險。
輝達法律壓力層層疊加。司法部同時在審查輝達以129億美元收購開源平台Hugging Face的交易，並對其收購與經營行為展開更廣泛的反托拉斯調查。
paras_en: Reuters on the 20th reported that insiders revealed SEC enforcement officers are reviewing potential accounting issues at Nvidia (NVDA-US), adding legal pressure to the chip giant mired in scandal.

The Wall Street Journal first reported on Tuesday that the SEC has launched an investigation into Nvidia, but could not confirm the focus; insiders told Reuters that the SEC is targeting accounting matters, a detail that has not been disclosed before.
A SEC spokesperson declined to comment, and Nvidia’s spokesperson did not immediately respond; the investigation does not imply wrongdoing, and many such probes never lead to enforcement action.

After the story broke, Nvidia’s stock fell further. According to LSEG data, the shares dropped about 13% on Friday, whereas before the investigation details were released the decline had been over 6%.

Nvidia’s accounting disclosure method has recently attracted attention. The company changed last year to segment revenue by customer headquarters rather than billing address, claiming it better reflects geographic distribution; Singapore was removed from the regional split as a result.

The Financial Times cited company accounts on Tuesday, noting that at the time of the change Singapore sales had surged to nearly half of Nvidia’s global revenue; since the U.S. imposed controls on advanced AI chip exports to China, Southeast Asia has become a hub for chip smuggling and transshipment.

Analysts and investors are increasingly concerned about AI cycle financing deals: chip makers use complex financial arrangements to help customers purchase chips and build data centers. Critics argue such arrangements make revenue quality and real financial exposure harder to assess.
SEC enforcement chief David Woodcock told Reuters last month that the agency is reviewing AI companies’ corporate disclosures to ensure issuers fully explain potential risks to investors.

Nvidia faces mounting legal pressure. The Department of Justice is also reviewing the company’s $12.9 billion acquisition of the open‑source platform Hugging Face, and has launched a broader antitrust probe into its acquisition and operating practices.

items.title: 川普擬禁美企海外建資料中心！微軟、Google在台布局添變數
items.title_en: Trump Plans to Ban U.S. Companies from Building Overseas Data Centers, Adding Uncertainty to Microsoft and Google's Taiwan Plans
paras: 美國總統川普週五 (20 日) 表示，不會允許美國企業在海外興建資料中心，並揚言對不配合的公司課徵「巨額稅負」，要求企業將投資留在美國。市場分析，這項構想勢必為美商在台資料中心的後續布局增添政策變數。
不過，川普坦言尚未與幕僚討論，相關限制是否涵蓋台灣、既有工程及合作開發模式，仍待釐清。
川普週五在白宮記者會上表示：「我們不會允許我們的企業在國外興建資料中心。我們不會讓這種事情發生。」
他將資料中心投資與過去晶片產業外移相提並論，認為美國曾允許晶片及其他產業移往海外，對國家造成重大傷害。
「他們讓晶片和其他各種東西發生這種情況，這對我們國家極具破壞性。那就是我們開始落後的時候。」川普說。
不過，他隨即補充：「這是個最新消息，但我甚至還沒跟我的幕僚說過。」顯示這項限制海外資料中心投資的構想，尚待政府進一步說明如何執行。
川普表示，若美國企業仍赴海外興建資料中心，將面臨「巨額稅負」。
他還警告，若任由這些資料中心落腳其他國家，「中國會把它們全部拿走」，但未進一步解釋具體所指。
川普這項構想勢必為美商在台資料中心的後續布局增添政策變數
對台灣而言，微軟 (MSFT-US) 的資料中心擴建是值得關注的布局。
台灣微軟總經理卞志祥今年 9 月表示，因應未來兩至三年 AI 算力需求持續高於供給，微軟正積極在台擴建資料中心，整體架構將由原先兩座擴充為四座。
若美方後續措施涵蓋海外新增設施或擴建投資，相關建置與資金配置可能面臨重新評估。
Google 母公司 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 在台南、雲林的潛在資料中心規畫，也可能面臨新的政策不確定性。
此外，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 旗下 AWS 已於 2025 年 6 月啟用亞太 (台北) 區域，並承諾長期在台投資超過 50 億美元，用於資料中心建設、連網、營運與維護。
因此，後續政策是否僅限制新建案，或連既有區域的擴充投資也納入，將影響其在台布局的評估。
同樣值得注意的是，政策如何認定企業角色？例如輝達 (NVDA-US) 參與鴻海在台 AI 超級運算中心建置，但由鴻海體系主導開發，與美商自行投資興建的模式不同。
美方是否將設備供應、技術合作、租用機房或採購算力納入限制，川普此次談話均未交代，目前無法據此判定相關合作案受限。
為推動投資留在國內，川普週四強調，美國仍有許多地區願意接納資料中心，企業不必因部分地方不歡迎而轉向海外。
「我們希望他們在這裡興建。如果他們不去德州、不去加州，那就去西維吉尼亞州。」他說，「我們有很多地方非常想要它們，而且都是很棒的地方。」
川普也以資料中心密集的維吉尼亞州勞登郡 (Loudoun County) 為例，形容當地「賺了這麼多錢，多到不知道該怎麼用」，呼籲地方政府善用資料中心帶來的經濟效益。
「你們必須善用資料中心。讓它們付錢給你們，讓它們為你們的社區付費。」他表示，「但要把握機會，不要把它們拒於門外。」
這番表態延續川普對美中人工智慧競爭的關注。他多次強調，美國必須在這場競賽中勝出，並以「超級智慧」(Super Intelligence，SI) 稱呼人工智慧 (AI)。
川普於週四晚間結束菲律賓與中國行程、返回華府。出訪期間，他與多位國際領袖會面，包括中國國家主席習近平及俄羅斯總統普丁。
川普透露，習近平曾「恭喜」美國在 AI 發展上的表現，也認同使用 SI 這個名稱。
「就像他說的，這比較準確。它是超級的，不是人工智慧。它不是人工的，而是超級的。」川普說，隨後又補上一句：「問題是，它可能太超級了。」
另外，川普提到，兩人同意共同為 AI 設立安全規範，但未在這段談話中進一步說明具體措施。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 20th) that he will not allow American companies to build data centers overseas and threatened to levy "massive taxes" on non‑compliant firms, demanding that investment stay in the United States. Analysts say the proposal will inevitably add a policy variable to the future rollout of data centers by U.S. firms in Taiwan.
However, Trump admitted he has not yet discussed the idea with his staff, and it remains unclear whether any restrictions would cover Taiwan, existing projects or collaborative development models.
At a White House press briefing on Friday, Trump said: "We will not allow our companies to build data centers abroad. We will not let that happen."
He likened data‑center investment to the past offshoring of the chip industry, arguing that allowing chips and other sectors to move overseas caused serious damage to the country.
"They let chips and all kinds of things happen that way, and that is extremely destructive to our nation. That's when we started falling behind," Trump said.

He quickly added, "This is brand‑new, but I haven't even told my staff about it," indicating that the concept of restricting overseas data‑center investment still requires further government clarification on how it would be implemented.
Trump said that any U.S. company that still builds a data center abroad would face a "massive tax burden."
He also warned that if these data centers are allowed to locate in other countries, "China will take them all," though he did not elaborate on what he meant.
Trump's proposal is sure to add a policy variable to the future rollout of data centers by U.S. firms in Taiwan.
For Taiwan, Microsoft’s (MSFT‑US) data‑center expansion is a development to watch.

Microsoft Taiwan general manager Bian Zhixiang said in September that, in response to AI compute demand outpacing supply for the next two to three years, Microsoft is actively expanding its data‑center footprint in Taiwan, growing from two sites to four.
If U.S. measures later cover new overseas facilities or expansion investments, the related construction and capital allocation may need to be reassessed.
Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Google’s parent, has potential data‑center plans in Tainan and Yunlin, which could also face new policy uncertainty.

In addition, Amazon’s (AMZN‑US) AWS launched the Asia‑Pacific (Taipei) region in June 2025 and pledged to invest over $5 billion long‑term in Taiwan for data‑center construction, networking, operations and maintenance.
Thus, whether future policy only limits new builds or also includes expansion of existing sites will affect how these companies evaluate their Taiwan deployments.

Equally noteworthy is how the policy defines a company’s role. For example, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) is involved in Foxconn’s AI super‑computing center in Taiwan, but the project is led by Foxconn’s ecosystem rather than a direct U.S. investment model.

It remains unclear whether the U.S. will restrict equipment supply, technology cooperation, colocation or compute‑power purchases; Trump gave no details, so it cannot yet be determined which collaborations would be affected.

To keep investment domestic, Trump emphasized on Thursday that many regions in the United States are ready to host data centers, and companies need not turn overseas simply because some locales are unwelcoming.
"We want them to build here. If they don’t go to Texas or California, then they go to West Virginia," he said. "We have a lot of places that really want them, and they’re great places."

Trump cited Loudoun County, Virginia – a hotspot for data centers – saying the area has "made so much money it doesn’t know what to do with it," and urged local governments to make the most of the economic benefits.
"You have to make good use of data centers. Let them pay you, let them pay for your community," he said. "But seize the opportunity and don’t shut them out."
The remarks continue Trump’s focus on the U.S.–China AI competition. He has repeatedly stressed that America must win this race and refers to artificial intelligence as "Super Intelligence" (SI).

Trump concluded his Thursday evening trip, returning to Washington after stops in the Philippines and China, where he met several world leaders, including Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
Trump disclosed that Xi had "congratulated" the United States on its AI progress and also endorsed the use of the term SI.
"Just like he said, it’s more accurate. It’s super, not artificial intelligence. It’s not artificial, it’s super," Trump said, adding, "The problem is, it might be too super."
He also mentioned that the two leaders agreed to jointly establish safety standards for AI, though he gave no further details on specific measures.

items.title: 波蘭指控：俄製Kh-101飛彈又來 可能不只一枚
items.title_en: Poland Accuses: Russian‑made Kh‑101 Missile Returns, Possibly More Than One
paras: 波蘭20日（周五）表示，在俄羅斯連夜對烏克蘭發動襲擊期間，至少有一枚俄羅斯飛彈擊中波蘭東南部，波方正在調查三處撞擊地點。
波蘭國防部長瓦迪斯瓦夫·科西尼亞克-卡梅什說：「目前發現了三處撞擊地點。在諾維利波維茨（Nowy Lipowiec），我們已經能夠確認，擊中該地的是一枚Kh-101飛彈；第二處地點也有飛彈撞擊跡象；第三處地點很可能是一架噴氣式無人機。」
他說道：「沒有人受傷，我們也沒發現任何基礎設施遭破壞。」
這是波蘭方面今年來第二次指控俄方Kh-101飛彈墜落境內，此前一次是在7月30日，當時波方稱東部盧布林省塔納瓦-科洛尼亞附近發現一枚俄製Kh-101飛彈。
《France 24》指出，自烏克蘭戰爭爆發以來，俄方無人機多次誤入北約（NATO）東翼國家的領空，加劇了俄羅斯與北約的緊張關係，也引發外界對戰火可能蔓延的擔憂。
paras_en: Poland said on Friday the 20th that during Russia’s overnight attacks on Ukraine, at least one Russian missile struck southeastern Poland, and Polish authorities are investigating three impact sites.

Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak‑Kamień said, “We have identified three impact locations. In Nowy Lipowiec we have confirmed that the strike was caused by a Kh‑101 missile; the second site also shows evidence of a missile impact; the third site was likely hit by a jet‑powered unmanned aircraft.”
He added, “No one was injured and we did not find any damage to infrastructure.”

This is the second time this year that Poland has accused Russia of a Kh‑101 missile falling on its territory, the first being on July 30 when Polish officials said a Russian‑made Kh‑101 was found near Tanawa‑Kolonia in the eastern Lublin province.

France 24 noted that since the outbreak of the war in Ukraine, Russian drones have repeatedly entered the airspace of NATO’s eastern flank countries, heightening tensions between Russia and NATO and raising concerns that the fighting could spread further.

items.title: AI業務狂飆 輝達估值竟低於2013年！市場重評AI龍頭
items.title_en: AI Business Soars, NVIDIA Valuation Falls Below 2013 Levels! Market Reassesses AI Leader
paras: 輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US)正處於人工智慧產業高速成長的核心，AI業務持續創造數百億美元營收，然而公司股票估值卻已壓縮至低於2013年底的水準。當時輝達的業務規模僅是如今的一小部分，如今卻出現營運表現與股票估值背離的現象，也讓市場重新思考，華爾街是否對這家AI晶片龍頭過度保守。
輝達11月17日公布2027會計年度第三季財報，營收達1158億美元，年增103%，季增20%。其中，資料中心業務營收達1076億美元，年增110%，仍是公司最主要的成長引擎。
獲利表現同樣強勁，第三季淨利從去年同期的319億美元增至653億美元，超過一倍；稀釋後每股盈餘 (EPS) 達2.70美元，年增108%，顯示AI運算需求仍持續轉化為實際營收與獲利。
展望下一季，輝達預估第四季營收約1300億美元，上下浮動3%，預測區間約為1261億至1339億美元。這一季將比一般季度多一週，且財測假設不包含來自中國的資料中心運算營收，顯示公司在未計入中國相關收入的情況下，仍預期業務維持強勁成長。
輝達臨時執行長兼財務長Colette Kress在財報聲明中表示，公司成長動能真實且持續，Vera Rubin產品路線圖仍按計畫推進。公司並確認，下一代Vera Rubin NVL72平台已開始出貨，為後續AI運算產品世代建立基礎。
然而，營運高速成長並未阻止股票估值持續下滑。根據Benzinga Pro數據，輝達目前追蹤本益比為15.68倍，預估本益比僅9.24倍，PEG比率則為0.178倍。PEG比率用來比較本益比與預期獲利成長，數值偏低代表股價相對預期成長的估值較低。
歷史數據更凸顯這次估值修正的幅度。根據CompaniesMarketCap資料，輝達2013年底本益比為19.6倍，2014年底為18.3倍，2018年底則為17.1倍。以Benzinga Pro目前的15.68倍計算，已低於上述三個歷史基準。
從近五年變化來看，輝達本益比曾在2023年一度突破200倍，隨後於2024年至2026年一路下滑。這反映投資人對AI產業的成長預期，已從過去願意支付極高溢價，轉向更重視獲利能否持續、資本支出是否合理，以及未來需求能否支撐目前的營運規模。
股價近期也承受沉重賣壓。根據Benzinga Pro報價，輝達周五 (20日) 盤中一度下跌6.95%，報135.83美元，顯示即使財報營收、獲利及下一季展望均維持強勁，市場仍未完全消除對AI投資熱潮可持續性的疑慮。
不過，低本益比並不必然代表股票遭到低估。估值下降也可能反映投資人開始擔心AI基礎設施支出放緩、競爭加劇，或大型客戶對資本支出的態度轉趨謹慎。若未來需求成長不如預期，市場目前採用的獲利預估也可能下修，進而改變本益比所呈現的便宜程度。
因此，投資人接下來需要關注幾項指標，包括資料中心業務成長速度、毛利率變化、大型客戶的資本支出，以及管理層對未來營收的財測。這些因素將決定輝達目前的低估值，究竟反映市場過度悲觀，還是投資人正在重新評估AI基礎建設熱潮的持續時間。
對輝達而言，當前最值得關注的矛盾在於，AI業務仍以三位數年增率擴張，股票估值卻已回落至十多年前的水準。若公司能持續將AI需求轉化為營收與獲利，估值落差可能成為市場重新評價的契機；但若AI投資熱潮降溫，低本益比也未必能阻止股價進一步修正。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) is at the core of the fast‑growing artificial‑intelligence industry, with its AI business generating hundreds of billions of dollars in revenue, yet the stock’s valuation has compressed to below the level seen at the end of 2013. Back then NVIDIA’s scale was only a fraction of today’s, and now a disconnect between operating performance and stock valuation is prompting the market to rethink whether Wall Street has been overly conservative on the AI chip leader.

On November 17, NVIDIA reported its fiscal 2027 third‑quarter results, posting revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year‑over‑year and 20% sequentially. Data‑center revenue reached $107.6 billion, a 110% annual increase, remaining the company’s primary growth engine.

Profitability was equally strong, with third‑quarter net income rising from $31.9 billion a year earlier to $65.3 billion, more than double. Diluted earnings per share were $2.70, up 108% year‑over‑year, showing AI compute demand continues to translate into real revenue and profit.

Looking ahead to the next quarter, NVIDIA forecasts fourth‑quarter revenue of roughly $130 billion, give or take 3%, i.e., a range of $126.1 billion to $133.9 billion. This quarter will be a week longer than a typical quarter, and the outlook excludes data‑center revenue from China, indicating the company still expects strong growth even without Chinese‑related income.

Interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress said in the earnings release that the company’s growth momentum is genuine and ongoing, and the Vera Rubin product roadmap remains on schedule. She confirmed that the next‑generation Vera Rubin NVL72 platform has already begun shipping, laying the foundation for future AI compute generations.

However, rapid operating growth has not stopped the stock’s valuation from sliding. According to Benzinga Pro, NVIDIA’s current trailing P/E is 15.68×, forward P/E is only 9.24×, and its PEG ratio stands at 0.178×. A low PEG indicates the share price is cheap relative to expected earnings growth.

Historical data highlight the magnitude of this valuation adjustment. CompaniesMarketCap shows NVIDIA’s year‑end 2013 P/E was 19.6×, 2014’s was 18.3×, and 2018’s was 17.1×. At today’s 15.68×, the valuation is already below those three historic benchmarks.

Over the past five years, NVIDIA’s P/E peaked above 200× in 2023 before falling steadily from 2024 through 2026. This reflects investors shifting from paying extreme premiums for AI growth to focusing more on sustainable profitability, reasonable capex, and whether future demand can support the current scale.

The stock has also faced heavy selling pressure recently. Benzinga Pro data show that on Friday the 20th, NVIDIA fell as much as 6.95% intraday to $135.83, indicating that even with strong revenue, profit and next‑quarter outlook, the market has not fully dispelled doubts about the durability of the AI investment boom.

Nevertheless, a low P/E does not automatically mean the stock is undervalued. The valuation decline may also signal investor concerns about slowing AI infrastructure spending, heightened competition, or large customers becoming more cautious with capex. If demand growth falls short of expectations, profit forecasts could be revised down, altering the perceived cheapness of the P/E.

Consequently, investors will need to watch several indicators, including data‑center growth rates, margin trends, large‑customer capex behavior, and management’s revenue guidance. These factors will determine whether NVIDIA’s low valuation reflects excessive market pessimism or a genuine reassessment of the AI infrastructure boom’s longevity.

For NVIDIA, the key paradox is that AI revenue continues to expand at triple‑digit annual rates while the stock’s valuation has slipped back to levels seen more than a decade ago. If the company can keep turning AI demand into revenue and profit, the valuation gap could become a catalyst for a market re‑rating; but if the AI hype cools, a low P/E may not prevent further price corrections.

items.title: 加密私訊仍怕AI看螢幕！Signal推預設封鎖截圖 批Siri與Gemini「尤其令人擔心」
items.title_en: Encrypted Messaging Still Fears AI Watching Screens! Signal to Enable Screenshot Blocking by Default, Criticizes Siri and Gemini as “Especially Worrying”
paras: 加密通訊軟體Signal 20日宣布，將預設開啟截圖封鎖功能，防止AI代理讀取手機上的私人訊息，並警告科技業把AI嵌入消費裝置的趨勢，正在侵蝕隱私保障。
Signal總裁Meredith Whittaker坦言新防護仍「不完整」，呼籲蘋果(AAPL-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)與微軟(MSFT-US)提供更具體的阻擋工具。
Signal同時要求三家公司揭露其AI代理的運作與資料存取方式，讓開發者能評估代理接觸了哪些資料，並據此調整系統。
Signal點名作業系統內建的蘋果Siri AI與Google Gemini Intelligence特別令人憂心，稱這類代理式AI整合「對隱私日益敵意」，對Signal構成「生存威脅」。
新功能預設阻擋手機截圖存取。當Signal偵測到截圖嘗試或AI助理試圖存取螢幕，用戶會收到彈出視窗，可選擇是否關閉封鎖，實際形式因裝置而異。
《路透社》本週稍早披露，Meta(META-US)的Muse代理繞過官方Connector工具，利用初始設定取得的系統層級權限，讀取蘋果電腦與Android手機上的Signal訊息。
在macOS上，Muse挪用蘋果為身障用戶設計的輔助使用與截圖工具，對Signal聊天截圖、擷取文字後複製到Muse應用內。蘋果本週更新雖堵住此路徑，但新增的代理權限組仍提供類似能力。
Meta回應《路透社》報導時表示，AI代理需要看到並操作電腦才能代用戶工作，Muse只能透過用戶明確授權的權限存取其他App。蘋果、Google與微軟未立即回應置評請求。
Signal去年已在Windows平台封鎖微軟Recall AI截圖，但表示在macOS上無法可靠提供同類防護；Signal由非營利基金會持有，以端到端加密保護訊息。
Signal主張，開發者應有簡單直接的方式，讓App完全退出AI助理對螢幕讀取、通知與檔案系統的資料處理。
paras_en: Signal announced on the 20th that it will enable a screenshot‑blocking feature by default to prevent AI agents from reading private messages on phones, warning that the tech industry’s trend of embedding AI into consumer devices is eroding privacy protections.
Signal CEO Meredith Whittaker admitted the new protection is still “incomplete” and called on Apple (AAPL‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) to provide more concrete blocking tools.

Signal also demanded that the three companies disclose how their AI agents operate and access data so developers can assess what information the agents have touched and adjust their systems accordingly.

Signal singled out the built‑in Apple Siri AI and Google Gemini Intelligence as particularly concerning, saying such agent‑style AI integrations are becoming “increasingly hostile to privacy” and pose a “survival threat” to Signal.

The new feature defaults to blocking apps from accessing screenshots. When Signal detects a screenshot attempt or an AI assistant trying to read the screen, users see a pop‑up window and can choose whether to lift the block; the exact implementation varies by device.

Reuters earlier this week reported that Meta’s (META‑US) Muse agent bypassed the official Connector tool, using system‑level permissions obtained at setup to read Signal messages on both Apple computers and Android phones.

On macOS, Muse hijacked Apple’s accessibility and screenshot tools designed for users with disabilities, capturing Signal chat screenshots, extracting text, and copying it into the Muse app; Apple’s update this week closed that pathway, but a newly added agent‑permission group still grants similar capabilities.

Meta responded to the Reuters report by saying AI agents need to see and manipulate the computer to act on a user’s behalf, and that Muse can only access other apps through permissions explicitly granted by the user; Apple, Google and Microsoft did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Signal said it blocked Microsoft’s Recall AI screenshot feature on Windows last year, but that it cannot reliably provide the same protection on macOS; Signal is owned by a nonprofit foundation and protects messages with end‑to‑end encryption.
Signal argues that developers should have a simple, direct way to let apps fully opt out of AI assistants reading screens, notifications and file‑system data.

He also expects that the current U.S. policy on exporting Nvidia (NVDA‑US) chips will remain unchanged and emphasized that China’s firms will be barred from remotely accessing advanced AI computing resources through overseas data centers.

The remarks add uncertainty to the overseas expansion plans of major U.S. cloud providers, and Trump noted that even his staff were hearing the idea for the first time.

President Trump on Friday (the 20th) publicly called on Nvidia (NVDA‑US) to allow former CEO Jensen Huang to return to the company, calling him one of the smartest people in the world and deserving of a “second chance.” However, Nvidia’s board this week made it clear it has no intention of reinstating Huang as CEO.

paras: 伺服器滑軌廠川湖(2059-TW)近期遭遇大盤拖累賣壓，20日股價持續走弱並打入跌停板5350元作收，下跌590元或9.93%，累計已連7個交易日收黑且波段跌幅達38.72%。儘管本周股價大幅修正，不過外資逆勢買超42張並寫下連2買，累計買超達299張。
其中第三季單季表現更是創下歷史新高，單季營收來到173.4億元、季增逾六成，單季毛利率攀升至88.2個百分點、營益率達82.9個百分點，單季稅後純益為117.0億元，單季每股純益高達122.79元。法人分析指出，第三季獲利爆發主要受惠於客戶新平台推出，帶動高毛利的新世代產品出貨比重提升與產品組合持續優化。
針對短期營運節奏與中長期展望，川湖第四季雖受產品世代轉換影響使營運動能暫時放緩，但法人看好2027年下半年起新平台產品放量將挹注新一波成長動能，對其長線競爭力維持正向看法，預估川湖在GB與VR以及ASIC人工智慧伺服器滑軌市場的市占率超過八成，隨著客製化獨立機櫃設計需求擴大，2026至2027年伺服器滑軌營收占比上看95%-97%。
為因應全球雲端服務供應商強勁的算力設備需求，川湖已提前啟動新一輪產能擴充計畫，美國休士頓新廠於今年9月至10月間正式啟動量產以就近服務北美客戶。同時台灣川億三期與五期廠房擴建進度也較原定規劃提前一年半至兩年，預計新增樓地板面積22萬平方公尺並使現有產能翻倍，加上川湖二廠將於明年完工加入量產，為中長期業績提供充足產能支撐。
paras_en: Server rail manufacturer Chuanhu (2059‑TW) recently faced market‑wide selling pressure, and on the 20th its share price kept weakening, hitting the daily limit down at NT$5,350, down NT$590 or 9.93%. This marks the seventh consecutive trading day of losses and a cumulative decline of 38.72% for the session. Despite the sharp correction this week, foreign investors bought 42 lots against the trend, logging a second consecutive buying day and a total net purchase of 299 lots.

In the third quarter, the company posted a record‑high single‑quarter performance: revenue reached NT$17.34 billion, up more than 60% quarter‑over‑quarter; gross margin climbed to 88.2 percentage points and operating margin hit 82.9 percentage points; net profit after tax was NT$11.70 billion, and earnings per share surged to NT$122.79. Analysts said the profit explosion was mainly driven by customers launching new platforms, which boosted shipments of high‑margin next‑generation products and continued product‑mix optimization.

Regarding short‑term operating rhythm and mid‑to‑long‑term outlook, Chuanhu’s fourth quarter may see a temporary slowdown in momentum due to a product‑generation transition. Nevertheless, analysts are optimistic that from the second half of 2027 onward, new‑platform products will scale up, injecting a fresh wave of growth. They maintain a positive view on the company’s long‑term competitiveness, estimating that Chuanhu will hold over 80% market share in the GB, VR and ASIC AI server rail markets, and that server‑rail revenue will account for 95%‑97% of total sales in 2026‑2027 as customized independent rack designs expand.

To meet the strong demand for compute equipment from global cloud service providers, Chuanhu has already launched a new round of capacity expansion. A new plant in Houston, USA, began mass production in September‑October this year to serve North American customers more closely. Meanwhile, the expansion of Taiwan’s Phase‑3 and Phase‑5 facilities has been accelerated by 1.5‑2 years, adding 220,000 square meters of floor space and doubling existing capacity. In addition, Phase‑2 will be completed next year and join mass production, providing ample capacity support for mid‑to‑long‑term earnings.

items.title_en: Investment Mindset Tutorial: Nvidia's Bright Forecast Yet Stock Falls—Reverse Valuation Shows How Pessimistic the Market Is
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 輝達(NVDA-US)第三季營收達1,158億美元，年增103%，下一季營收財測也以1,300億美元高於市場共識。但股價在財報公布後一度上漲，隔天卻收跌。隨後，加州司法部向輝達發出調查傳票，要求公司說明先進晶片或機密資訊是否流向中國，以及對投資人的揭露是否有誤導。財報和財測讓2026年的獲利大致有了底，真正變得難估的是未來幾年。
晨星在加州發出傳票前的財報評論中指出，輝達在尋找新執行長期間，短期營運仍維持成長。公司上季在中國銷售24億美元獲許可的H200產品，下一季財測則未納入直接來自中國客戶的資料中心營收。面對出口限制，輝達預期其他客戶能消化原本供應受限市場的晶片，因此沒有下修成長展望。不過，晨星仍維持「極高不確定性」評估，因為財報表現好，並不代表接班、技術競爭和地緣政治風險已經消失。

不先猜未來，先看股價在假設什麼
一般做折現估值，是先估未來獲利，再換算成今天的價值。反推估值則倒過來，從現在的股價出發。輝達公布最新財測後，2026年的獲利已大致底定，因此可以用2026年的預估獲利作為基期。在給定折現率與第五年之後的長期成長率後，再倒推未來五年的獲利平均每年要成長多少，才能解釋現在的股價。
依這組估值假設，輝達目前的股價約相當於未來五年獲利年均成長2%至3%。這不是對未來的預測，而是一個比較基準：把接班、出口管制和競爭風險都算進去後，你估出的保守成長率，會比股價隱含的2%至3%更高，還是更低？

先把景氣高低拉平，再看有沒有安全邊際
用折線模型反推，有個缺點：它不會告訴你哪一年獲利會下滑、哪一年會回升。同樣是五年年均成長2%至3%，可能是每年小幅成長，也可能是前兩年衰退、後三年回升。實際的盈餘路徑不同，折現後的價值也不會完全一樣。所以這個數字適合用來判斷跨景氣的獲利水準，不適合拿來預測下一季財報或景氣反轉的時間。
更重要的是，今年獲利大致底定，不代表今年的獲利就是常態。如果供不應求把價格和毛利率推到高檔，用這樣的獲利當起點，反推出來的成長率就容易偏低，讓股價看起來比實際更便宜。因此，還要用供需較平衡時能維持的獲利重算一次。如果換成這個基期、把風險算進去之後，保守估值仍高於現價，兩者的差距才是安全邊際。
折現模型不會讓你更確定未來會怎麼走，但能讓你看清楚，就算未來沒有想像中好，今天付的價格還留了多少犯錯空間。

paras_en: November 20, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Nvidia (NVDA-US) posted third‑quarter revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year‑over‑year, and its outlook for the next quarter projects $130 billion, above market consensus. The stock rose briefly after the earnings release but closed lower the next day. Subsequently, the California Department of Justice issued a subpoena to Nvidia, demanding explanations on whether advanced chips or confidential information have been transferred to China and whether disclosures to investors were misleading. The earnings and guidance set a rough floor for 2026 profits, but estimating the years ahead remains difficult.

Morningstar’s commentary, issued before the California subpoena, noted that while Nvidia searches for a new CEO, short‑term operations continue to grow. Last quarter the company sold $2.4 billion of its approved H200 product in China, but the next‑quarter outlook does not include data‑center revenue directly from Chinese customers. Facing export restrictions, Nvidia expects other customers to absorb chips that can no longer be sold to the restricted market, so it has not lowered its growth outlook. Nevertheless, Morningstar maintains a “very high uncertainty” rating, because strong earnings do not eliminate succession, technology‑competition, and geopolitical risks.

Don’t guess the future first—look at what the stock price assumes. In a traditional discounted‑cash‑flow valuation you forecast future earnings and discount them to today. A reverse valuation works backward, starting from the current price. After Nvidia released its latest guidance, 2026 earnings are roughly set, so they can serve as the base year. Given a discount rate and a long‑term growth rate beyond year five, you can back‑solve how much average annual earnings growth over the next five years is required to justify today’s price.

Using this set of assumptions, Nvidia’s current share price implies an average annual earnings growth of about 2%–3% over the next five years. This is not a forecast but a benchmark: after accounting for succession, export controls and competitive risks, does your conservative growth estimate come out higher or lower than the 2%–3% implied by the market?

Flatten the business cycle first, then assess any margin of safety. The reverse‑DCF line‑chart method has a drawback: it doesn’t tell you which year earnings will dip or rebound. A 2%–3% five‑year average could mean modest growth every year, or a decline in the first two years followed by a recovery in the last three. Different earnings paths yield slightly different discounted values. Thus the figure is useful for gauging profit levels across cycles, not for predicting the next quarter’s results or the timing of a cycle turn.

More importantly, a roughly set 2026 profit does not mean that level is sustainable. If supply‑demand imbalances push prices and margins to the high end, using that profit as a base will produce a reverse‑derived growth rate that is too low, making the stock appear cheaper than it really is. You should recalculate using a profit level that could be maintained when supply and demand are more balanced. If, after adjusting the base and incorporating risks, a conservative valuation still exceeds the current price, the gap represents your margin of safety.
The discounted‑cash‑flow model won’t make the future any more certain, but it clarifies how much error‑room remains in today’s price even if outcomes turn out worse than imagined.

items.title: 光通訊｜明泰投資兆輝電子，布局AI資料中心Micro LED光互連
items.title_en: Optical Communications | Ming Tai Invests in Zhaohui Electronics, Positioning AI Data Center Micro LED Optical Interconnects
paras: 2026年11月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 佳世達集團旗下網通廠明泰(3380-TW)11月19日宣布投資光通訊新創兆輝電子，雙方將探索Micro LED光互連技術的共同驗證與系統整合。明泰已推出1.6T高速交換器，這次投資把布局從交換器延伸到設備之間如何以更低耗電傳輸資料。
AI資料中心要在運算設備之間傳送大量資料，除了提高傳輸速度，也要控制傳輸所需的電力。兆輝的做法是把Micro LED當作傳送訊號的光源，讓多個通道同時傳輸，以提高整體頻寬並降低耗電為目標。這裡的Micro LED不是拿來顯示畫面，而是用來傳資料。
雙方分工上，兆輝提供光互連技術，明泰則有網通設備設計與整合能力。明泰目前公布的是探索共同驗證與系統整合的機會，並未表示這項技術已導入既有的1.6T交換器，也未公布量產時程。

paras_en: On November 19, 2026, Ming Tai (3380‑TW), the networking subsidiary of the JASDAQ Group, announced an investment in optical‑communication startup Zhaohui Electronics. The two companies will jointly explore verification and system integration of Micro LED optical interconnect technology. Ming Tai has already launched a 1.6‑terabit high‑speed switch, and this investment extends its focus from switches to how devices can transmit data with lower power consumption.

AI data centers need to move massive amounts of data between compute units. In addition to higher transmission speeds, power consumption must be controlled. Zhaohui’s approach uses Micro LEDs as light sources for signal transmission, enabling multiple channels to operate simultaneously to boost overall bandwidth while reducing energy use. Here, the Micro LEDs are not for display but for data transfer.

In the partnership, Zhaohui will provide the optical interconnect technology, while Ming Tai contributes its networking equipment design and integration expertise. Ming Tai has only announced the opportunity to explore joint verification and system integration; it has not said the technology is already incorporated into its existing 1.6‑terabit switch, nor has it disclosed a mass‑production timeline.

items.title_en: Jingcheng Earnings Call: Jingcheng Deploys Two New Fiber Optic Patent Technologies to Market, Unaffected by AI Demand Slowdown Concerns, Expands Production
paras: 特殊氣體廠晶呈科技(4768-TW)今(20)日舉行法說會，針對全球AI市場波動，有法人指出，全球AI有減緩需求的發展疑慮。晶呈科技董事長陳亞理今在法說上表示，目前AI客戶需求未變，公司正積極擴大TGV(玻璃通孔)擴產計畫也如期推進，明(2027)年底前將累計完成建置12條產線。
晶呈也在法說上展現2項光纖自動化組裝相關專利技術，並透過技術整合加快CPO(共同封裝光學)相關產品的商業化進程。
晶呈表示，從目前接收到AI領域客戶訊息顯示，需求面上產品及出貨數量仍維持穩定，素前TGV Glass Core主要客戶集中於通訊ASIC下的IC設計公司及CPO FAU領域。
晶呈指出，這2個區塊為主要市場，目前TGV成長幅度正逐步擴大，且晶呈TGV Glass Core Board是以既有氣態分解熔蝕技術發展的工藝，因此亦可用於非玻璃材料，公司對於未來前景展望非常樂觀。
此外，晶呈也在法說上展示，近期釋出的2項光纖自動化組裝相關專利技術，包括光纖自動穿入系統及內嵌式磁性導引光纖技術，將透過磁力牽引取代傳統機械推入方式，以提升FAU光纖組裝效率與良率。
晶呈表示，目前已與光纖製造商及設備開發商接洽合作，希望透過技術整合加快 CPO 相關產品的商業化進程，目前這項2項專利，自本(11)月起正式對外界推廣，初期市場反應非常不錯，公司正與潛在客戶洽談相關授權。
據晶呈提供資訊，目前晶呈的專利布局，截至今(2026)年10月31日為止，已取得103件、申請中49件(皆為發明專利)，其中TGV已取得9件、仍在申請中有18件。
paras_en: Specialty gas maker Jingcheng Technology (4768-TW) held its earnings conference today (20th). Regarding fluctuations in the global AI market, some institutional investors noted concerns that AI demand may be slowing. Chairman Chen Yali said at the conference that AI customer demand remains unchanged, and the company is actively expanding its TGV (through‑glass via) production plan, which is proceeding on schedule and aims to complete the construction of 12 production lines by the end of 2027.

Jingcheng also showcased two fiber‑optic automation assembly patent technologies during the conference and said it will accelerate the commercialization of CPO (co‑packaged optics) related products through technology integration.

Jingcheng indicated that messages received from AI‑sector customers show that product demand and shipment volumes remain stable. Its primary TGV Glass Core customers are IC design firms in the communications ASIC space and the CPO FAU (fiber‑array unit) field.

Jingcheng pointed out that these two segments constitute its main market. The TGV growth rate is gradually expanding, and the TGV Glass Core Board is developed using its existing gas‑phase etching technology, which can also be applied to non‑glass materials. The company is very optimistic about future prospects.

In addition, Jingcheng demonstrated two recently released fiber‑optic automation assembly patents, including an automatic fiber insertion system and an embedded magnetic‑guided fiber technology. The magnetic pull will replace traditional mechanical pushing to improve FAU fiber assembly efficiency and yield.

Jingcheng said it has already engaged fiber manufacturers and equipment developers to cooperate, aiming to speed up the commercialization of CPO products through technology integration. The two patents have been publicly promoted since this November, and early market response has been very positive; the company is negotiating licensing with potential customers.

According to information provided by Jingcheng, as of October 31, 2026, the company holds 103 granted patents and has 49 patent applications pending (all inventions). Among them, 9 TGV patents have been granted and 18 are pending.

items.title: 集保發布ESG評級與數據產品提供者行為準則 開放國內外機構簽署
items.title_en: CSDC Releases ESG Rating and Data Provider Code of Conduct, Opens Signing to Domestic and International Institutions
paras: 為提升台灣永續評級市場透明度與公信力，並與國際標準接軌，集保結算所近日於「台灣週—永續金融新篇章國際論壇」正式發布「ESG評級與數據產品提供者行為準則」，並於投資人關係整合平台（ESG IR平台）設置準則專區，開放國內外ESG評級及數據產品提供者自願簽署遵循。
集保結算所表示，有意簽署的機構可至ESG IR平台準則專區參閱相關資訊，並提交遵循聲明書完成簽署。簽署後，ESG評級機構須於6個月導入期內，數據產品提供者則須於12個月導入期內，自提交遵循聲明書之日起算，依準則附件格式向集保結算所提交自我評核文件，後續並須至少每年檢視一次，必要時更新。
此外，為引導機構投資人採用具公信力的永續評級資訊，116年「盡職治理資訊揭露較佳名單評比標準」也新增相關規範，要求機構投資人優先考量已簽署遵循行為準則的ESG評級機構，進一步提升永續評級資訊的透明度與合規性。
集保結算所指出，隨著市場對ESG評級透明度及合規性的重視日益提升，邀請國內外ESG評級與數據產品提供者踴躍簽署並落實自我評核，共同建立具公信力及國際互通性的台灣永續金融環境。
paras_en: To enhance the transparency and credibility of Taiwan's sustainable rating market and align it with international standards, the Central Securities Depository (CSDC) recently unveiled the "ESG Rating and Data Product Provider Code of Conduct" at the "Taiwan Week – New Chapter of Sustainable Finance International Forum." The code has been placed in a dedicated section on the Investor Relations Integration Platform (ESG IR Platform), allowing ESG rating agencies and data providers from both domestic and overseas to voluntarily sign and adhere to it.

CSDC states that institutions wishing to sign may visit the code section on the ESG IR Platform to review the relevant information and submit a compliance declaration to complete the signing. After signing, ESG rating agencies must implement the code within a six‑month transition period, while data product providers have a twelve‑month transition period. Starting from the submission date of the compliance declaration, they must submit self‑assessment documents to CSDC in the format attached to the code, and thereafter conduct at least an annual review and update as needed.

In addition, to guide institutional investors toward using credible sustainable rating information, the 2027 "Better Governance Information Disclosure Ranking Standards" have added related provisions, requiring institutional investors to give priority to ESG rating agencies that have signed the code of conduct, thereby further improving the transparency and compliance of sustainable rating information.

CSDC notes that as market attention to ESG rating transparency and compliance grows, it invites ESG rating agencies and data product providers worldwide to actively sign and carry out self‑assessments, jointly building a credible and internationally interoperable sustainable finance environment in Taiwan.

items.title: SEC執法盯上輝達會計 新加坡營收揭露方式再受檢視 輝達跌幅擴大至約13%
items.title_en: SEC Targets Nvidia Accounting, Singapore Revenue Disclosure Method Under Scrutiny, Shares Fall 13%
paras: 《路透社》20日獨家報導，知情人士透露，美國證券交易委員會(SEC)執法人員正在審查輝達(NVDA-US)的潛在會計問題，為這家醜聞纏身的晶片巨頭再添法律壓力。
《華爾街日報》週二率先報導SEC對輝達展開調查，但無法確認調查焦點；知情人士對《路透社》表示，SEC執法人員鎖定的是會計層面，這是調查方向首度曝光。
SEC發言人拒絕置評，輝達發言人未立即回應置評請求；調查不代表認定違規，此類調查許多最終未演變為執法行動。
報導刊出後，輝達股價跌幅擴大。據LSEG數據，輝達週五跌約13%，而在《路透社》刊出調查細節前，跌幅逾6%。
輝達的會計揭露方式近期已受關注。該公司去年改以客戶總部而非帳單地址劃分地區營收，稱更能反映營收地理分布，新加坡自此從地區拆分中移除。
《金融時報》週二引述公司帳目報導，這項變更之際，新加坡銷售額已飆升至輝達全球營收近半；自美國管制先進AI晶片出口中國以來，東南亞已成晶片走私轉運樞紐。
分析師與投資人也日益關切AI循環融資交易：晶片商以複雜財務安排協助客戶購置晶片、興建資料中心。批評者認為，這類安排使營收品質與真實財務曝險更難評估。
SEC執法主管David Woodcock上月對《路透社》表示，該機構正審查AI公司的企業揭露，確保發行人向投資人完整說明潛在風險。
輝達法律壓力層層疊加。司法部同時在審查輝達以129億美元收購開源平台Hugging Face的交易，並對其收購與經營行為展開更廣泛的反托拉斯調查。
paras_en: Reuters on the 20th reported that insiders revealed SEC enforcement officers are reviewing potential accounting issues at Nvidia (NVDA-US), adding legal pressure to the chip giant mired in scandal.

The Wall Street Journal first reported on Tuesday that the SEC has launched an investigation into Nvidia, but could not confirm the focus; insiders told Reuters that the SEC is targeting accounting matters, a detail that has not been disclosed before.
A SEC spokesperson declined to comment, and Nvidia’s spokesperson did not immediately respond; the investigation does not imply wrongdoing, and many such probes never lead to enforcement action.

After the story broke, Nvidia’s stock fell further. According to LSEG data, the shares dropped about 13% on Friday, whereas before the investigation details were released the decline had been over 6%.

Nvidia’s accounting disclosure method has recently attracted attention. The company changed last year to segment revenue by customer headquarters rather than billing address, claiming it better reflects geographic distribution; Singapore was removed from the regional split as a result.

The Financial Times cited company accounts on Tuesday, noting that at the time of the change Singapore sales had surged to nearly half of Nvidia’s global revenue; since the U.S. imposed controls on advanced AI chip exports to China, Southeast Asia has become a hub for chip smuggling and transshipment.

Analysts and investors are increasingly concerned about AI cycle financing deals: chip makers use complex financial arrangements to help customers purchase chips and build data centers. Critics argue such arrangements make revenue quality and real financial exposure harder to assess.
SEC enforcement chief David Woodcock told Reuters last month that the agency is reviewing AI companies’ corporate disclosures to ensure issuers fully explain potential risks to investors.

Nvidia faces mounting legal pressure. The Department of Justice is also reviewing the company’s $12.9 billion acquisition of the open‑source platform Hugging Face, and has launched a broader antitrust probe into its acquisition and operating practices.

items.title: 川普擬禁美企海外建資料中心！微軟、Google在台布局添變數
items.title_en: Trump Plans to Ban U.S. Companies from Building Overseas Data Centers, Adding Uncertainty to Microsoft and Google's Taiwan Plans
paras: 美國總統川普週五 (20 日) 表示，不會允許美國企業在海外興建資料中心，並揚言對不配合的公司課徵「巨額稅負」，要求企業將投資留在美國。市場分析，這項構想勢必為美商在台資料中心的後續布局增添政策變數。
不過，川普坦言尚未與幕僚討論，相關限制是否涵蓋台灣、既有工程及合作開發模式，仍待釐清。
川普週五在白宮記者會上表示：「我們不會允許我們的企業在國外興建資料中心。我們不會讓這種事情發生。」
他將資料中心投資與過去晶片產業外移相提並論，認為美國曾允許晶片及其他產業移往海外，對國家造成重大傷害。
「他們讓晶片和其他各種東西發生這種情況，這對我們國家極具破壞性。那就是我們開始落後的時候。」川普說。
不過，他隨即補充：「這是個最新消息，但我甚至還沒跟我的幕僚說過。」顯示這項限制海外資料中心投資的構想，尚待政府進一步說明如何執行。
川普表示，若美國企業仍赴海外興建資料中心，將面臨「巨額稅負」。
他還警告，若任由這些資料中心落腳其他國家，「中國會把它們全部拿走」，但未進一步解釋具體所指。
川普這項構想勢必為美商在台資料中心的後續布局增添政策變數
對台灣而言，微軟 (MSFT-US) 的資料中心擴建是值得關注的布局。
台灣微軟總經理卞志祥今年 9 月表示，因應未來兩至三年 AI 算力需求持續高於供給，微軟正積極在台擴建資料中心，整體架構將由原先兩座擴充為四座。
若美方後續措施涵蓋海外新增設施或擴建投資，相關建置與資金配置可能面臨重新評估。
Google 母公司 Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 在台南、雲林的潛在資料中心規畫，也可能面臨新的政策不確定性。
此外，亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 旗下 AWS 已於 2025 年 6 月啟用亞太 (台北) 區域，並承諾長期在台投資超過 50 億美元，用於資料中心建設、連網、營運與維護。
因此，後續政策是否僅限制新建案，或連既有區域的擴充投資也納入，將影響其在台布局的評估。
同樣值得注意的是，政策如何認定企業角色？例如輝達 (NVDA-US) 參與鴻海在台 AI 超級運算中心建置，但由鴻海體系主導開發，與美商自行投資興建的模式不同。
美方是否將設備供應、技術合作、租用機房或採購算力納入限制，川普此次談話均未交代，目前無法據此判定相關合作案受限。
為推動投資留在國內，川普週四強調，美國仍有許多地區願意接納資料中心，企業不必因部分地方不歡迎而轉向海外。
「我們希望他們在這裡興建。如果他們不去德州、不去加州，那就去西維吉尼亞州。」他說，「我們有很多地方非常想要它們，而且都是很棒的地方。」
川普也以資料中心密集的維吉尼亞州勞登郡 (Loudoun County) 為例，形容當地「賺了這麼多錢，多到不知道該怎麼用」，呼籲地方政府善用資料中心帶來的經濟效益。
「你們必須善用資料中心。讓它們付錢給你們，讓它們為你們的社區付費。」他表示，「但要把握機會，不要把它們拒於門外。」
這番表態延續川普對美中人工智慧競爭的關注。他多次強調，美國必須在這場競賽中勝出，並以「超級智慧」(Super Intelligence，SI) 稱呼人工智慧 (AI)。
川普於週四晚間結束菲律賓與中國行程、返回華府。出訪期間，他與多位國際領袖會面，包括中國國家主席習近平及俄羅斯總統普丁。
川普透露，習近平曾「恭喜」美國在 AI 發展上的表現，也認同使用 SI 這個名稱。
「就像他說的，這比較準確。它是超級的，不是人工智慧。它不是人工的，而是超級的。」川普說，隨後又補上一句：「問題是，它可能太超級了。」
另外，川普提到，兩人同意共同為 AI 設立安全規範，但未在這段談話中進一步說明具體措施。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 20th) that he will not allow American companies to build data centers overseas and threatened to levy "massive taxes" on non‑compliant firms, demanding that investment stay in the United States. Analysts say the proposal will inevitably add a policy variable to the future rollout of data centers by U.S. firms in Taiwan.
However, Trump admitted he has not yet discussed the idea with his staff, and it remains unclear whether any restrictions would cover Taiwan, existing projects or collaborative development models.
At a White House press briefing on Friday, Trump said: "We will not allow our companies to build data centers abroad. We will not let that happen."
He likened data‑center investment to the past offshoring of the chip industry, arguing that allowing chips and other sectors to move overseas caused serious damage to the country.
"They let chips and all kinds of things happen that way, and that is extremely destructive to our nation. That's when we started falling behind," Trump said.

He quickly added, "This is brand‑new, but I haven't even told my staff about it," indicating that the concept of restricting overseas data‑center investment still requires further government clarification on how it would be implemented.
Trump said that any U.S. company that still builds a data center abroad would face a "massive tax burden."
He also warned that if these data centers are allowed to locate in other countries, "China will take them all," though he did not elaborate on what he meant.
Trump's proposal is sure to add a policy variable to the future rollout of data centers by U.S. firms in Taiwan.
For Taiwan, Microsoft’s (MSFT‑US) data‑center expansion is a development to watch.

Microsoft Taiwan general manager Bian Zhixiang said in September that, in response to AI compute demand outpacing supply for the next two to three years, Microsoft is actively expanding its data‑center footprint in Taiwan, growing from two sites to four.
If U.S. measures later cover new overseas facilities or expansion investments, the related construction and capital allocation may need to be reassessed.
Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Google’s parent, has potential data‑center plans in Tainan and Yunlin, which could also face new policy uncertainty.

In addition, Amazon’s (AMZN‑US) AWS launched the Asia‑Pacific (Taipei) region in June 2025 and pledged to invest over $5 billion long‑term in Taiwan for data‑center construction, networking, operations and maintenance.
Thus, whether future policy only limits new builds or also includes expansion of existing sites will affect how these companies evaluate their Taiwan deployments.

Equally noteworthy is how the policy defines a company’s role. For example, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) is involved in Foxconn’s AI super‑computing center in Taiwan, but the project is led by Foxconn’s ecosystem rather than a direct U.S. investment model.

It remains unclear whether the U.S. will restrict equipment supply, technology cooperation, colocation or compute‑power purchases; Trump gave no details, so it cannot yet be determined which collaborations would be affected.

To keep investment domestic, Trump emphasized on Thursday that many regions in the United States are ready to host data centers, and companies need not turn overseas simply because some locales are unwelcoming.
"We want them to build here. If they don’t go to Texas or California, then they go to West Virginia," he said. "We have a lot of places that really want them, and they’re great places."

Trump cited Loudoun County, Virginia – a hotspot for data centers – saying the area has "made so much money it doesn’t know what to do with it," and urged local governments to make the most of the economic benefits.
"You have to make good use of data centers. Let them pay you, let them pay for your community," he said. "But seize the opportunity and don’t shut them out."
The remarks continue Trump’s focus on the U.S.–China AI competition. He has repeatedly stressed that America must win this race and refers to artificial intelligence as "Super Intelligence" (SI).

Trump concluded his Thursday evening trip, returning to Washington after stops in the Philippines and China, where he met several world leaders, including Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
Trump disclosed that Xi had "congratulated" the United States on its AI progress and also endorsed the use of the term SI.
"Just like he said, it’s more accurate. It’s super, not artificial intelligence. It’s not artificial, it’s super," Trump said, adding, "The problem is, it might be too super."
He also mentioned that the two leaders agreed to jointly establish safety standards for AI, though he gave no further details on specific measures.

items.title: AI業務狂飆 輝達估值竟低於2013年！市場重評AI龍頭
items.title_en: AI Business Soars, NVIDIA Valuation Falls Below 2013 Levels! Market Reassesses AI Leader
paras: 輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US)正處於人工智慧產業高速成長的核心，AI業務持續創造數百億美元營收，然而公司股票估值卻已壓縮至低於2013年底的水準。當時輝達的業務規模僅是如今的一小部分，如今卻出現營運表現與股票估值背離的現象，也讓市場重新思考，華爾街是否對這家AI晶片龍頭過度保守。
輝達11月17日公布2027會計年度第三季財報，營收達1158億美元，年增103%，季增20%。其中，資料中心業務營收達1076億美元，年增110%，仍是公司最主要的成長引擎。
獲利表現同樣強勁，第三季淨利從去年同期的319億美元增至653億美元，超過一倍；稀釋後每股盈餘 (EPS) 達2.70美元，年增108%，顯示AI運算需求仍持續轉化為實際營收與獲利。
展望下一季，輝達預估第四季營收約1300億美元，上下浮動3%，預測區間約為1261億至1339億美元。這一季將比一般季度多一週，且財測假設不包含來自中國的資料中心運算營收，顯示公司在未計入中國相關收入的情況下，仍預期業務維持強勁成長。
輝達臨時執行長兼財務長Colette Kress在財報聲明中表示，公司成長動能真實且持續，Vera Rubin產品路線圖仍按計畫推進。公司並確認，下一代Vera Rubin NVL72平台已開始出貨，為後續AI運算產品世代建立基礎。
然而，營運高速成長並未阻止股票估值持續下滑。根據Benzinga Pro數據，輝達目前追蹤本益比為15.68倍，預估本益比僅9.24倍，PEG比率則為0.178倍。PEG比率用來比較本益比與預期獲利成長，數值偏低代表股價相對預期成長的估值較低。
歷史數據更凸顯這次估值修正的幅度。根據CompaniesMarketCap資料，輝達2013年底本益比為19.6倍，2014年底為18.3倍，2018年底則為17.1倍。以Benzinga Pro目前的15.68倍計算，已低於上述三個歷史基準。
從近五年變化來看，輝達本益比曾在2023年一度突破200倍，隨後於2024年至2026年一路下滑。這反映投資人對AI產業的成長預期，已從過去願意支付極高溢價，轉向更重視獲利能否持續、資本支出是否合理，以及未來需求能否支撐目前的營運規模。
股價近期也承受沉重賣壓。根據Benzinga Pro報價，輝達周五 (20日) 盤中一度下跌6.95%，報135.83美元，顯示即使財報營收、獲利及下一季展望均維持強勁，市場仍未完全消除對AI投資熱潮可持續性的疑慮。
不過，低本益比並不必然代表股票遭到低估。估值下降也可能反映投資人開始擔心AI基礎設施支出放緩、競爭加劇，或大型客戶對資本支出的態度轉趨謹慎。若未來需求成長不如預期，市場目前採用的獲利預估也可能下修，進而改變本益比所呈現的便宜程度。
因此，投資人接下來需要關注幾項指標，包括資料中心業務成長速度、毛利率變化、大型客戶的資本支出，以及管理層對未來營收的財測。這些因素將決定輝達目前的低估值，究竟反映市場過度悲觀，還是投資人正在重新評估AI基礎建設熱潮的持續時間。
對輝達而言，當前最值得關注的矛盾在於，AI業務仍以三位數年增率擴張，股票估值卻已回落至十多年前的水準。若公司能持續將AI需求轉化為營收與獲利，估值落差可能成為市場重新評價的契機；但若AI投資熱潮降溫，低本益比也未必能阻止股價進一步修正。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) is at the core of the fast‑growing artificial‑intelligence industry, with its AI business generating hundreds of billions of dollars in revenue, yet the stock’s valuation has compressed to below the level seen at the end of 2013. Back then NVIDIA’s scale was only a fraction of today’s, and now a disconnect between operating performance and stock valuation is prompting the market to rethink whether Wall Street has been overly conservative on the AI chip leader.

On November 17, NVIDIA reported its fiscal 2027 third‑quarter results, posting revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% year‑over‑year and 20% sequentially. Data‑center revenue reached $107.6 billion, a 110% annual increase, remaining the company’s primary growth engine.

Profitability was equally strong, with third‑quarter net income rising from $31.9 billion a year earlier to $65.3 billion, more than double. Diluted earnings per share were $2.70, up 108% year‑over‑year, showing AI compute demand continues to translate into real revenue and profit.

Looking ahead to the next quarter, NVIDIA forecasts fourth‑quarter revenue of roughly $130 billion, give or take 3%, i.e., a range of $126.1 billion to $133.9 billion. This quarter will be a week longer than a typical quarter, and the outlook excludes data‑center revenue from China, indicating the company still expects strong growth even without Chinese‑related income.

Interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress said in the earnings release that the company’s growth momentum is genuine and ongoing, and the Vera Rubin product roadmap remains on schedule. She confirmed that the next‑generation Vera Rubin NVL72 platform has already begun shipping, laying the foundation for future AI compute generations.

However, rapid operating growth has not stopped the stock’s valuation from sliding. According to Benzinga Pro, NVIDIA’s current trailing P/E is 15.68×, forward P/E is only 9.24×, and its PEG ratio stands at 0.178×. A low PEG indicates the share price is cheap relative to expected earnings growth.

Historical data highlight the magnitude of this valuation adjustment. CompaniesMarketCap shows NVIDIA’s year‑end 2013 P/E was 19.6×, 2014’s was 18.3×, and 2018’s was 17.1×. At today’s 15.68×, the valuation is already below those three historic benchmarks.

Over the past five years, NVIDIA’s P/E peaked above 200× in 2023 before falling steadily from 2024 through 2026. This reflects investors shifting from paying extreme premiums for AI growth to focusing more on sustainable profitability, reasonable capex, and whether future demand can support the current scale.

The stock has also faced heavy selling pressure recently. Benzinga Pro data show that on Friday the 20th, NVIDIA fell as much as 6.95% intraday to $135.83, indicating that even with strong revenue, profit and next‑quarter outlook, the market has not fully dispelled doubts about the durability of the AI investment boom.

Nevertheless, a low P/E does not automatically mean the stock is undervalued. The valuation decline may also signal investor concerns about slowing AI infrastructure spending, heightened competition, or large customers becoming more cautious with capex. If demand growth falls short of expectations, profit forecasts could be revised down, altering the perceived cheapness of the P/E.

Consequently, investors will need to watch several indicators, including data‑center growth rates, margin trends, large‑customer capex behavior, and management’s revenue guidance. These factors will determine whether NVIDIA’s low valuation reflects excessive market pessimism or a genuine reassessment of the AI infrastructure boom’s longevity.

For NVIDIA, the key paradox is that AI revenue continues to expand at triple‑digit annual rates while the stock’s valuation has slipped back to levels seen more than a decade ago. If the company can keep turning AI demand into revenue and profit, the valuation gap could become a catalyst for a market re‑rating; but if the AI hype cools, a low P/E may not prevent further price corrections.

items.title: 加密私訊仍怕AI看螢幕！Signal推預設封鎖截圖 批Siri與Gemini「尤其令人擔心」
items.title_en: Encrypted Messaging Still Fears AI Watching Screens! Signal to Enable Screenshot Blocking by Default, Criticizes Siri and Gemini as “Especially Worrying”
paras: 加密通訊軟體Signal 20日宣布，將預設開啟截圖封鎖功能，防止AI代理讀取手機上的私人訊息，並警告科技業把AI嵌入消費裝置的趨勢，正在侵蝕隱私保障。
Signal總裁Meredith Whittaker坦言新防護仍「不完整」，呼籲蘋果(AAPL-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)與微軟(MSFT-US)提供更具體的阻擋工具。
Signal同時要求三家公司揭露其AI代理的運作與資料存取方式，讓開發者能評估代理接觸了哪些資料，並據此調整系統。
Signal點名作業系統內建的蘋果Siri AI與Google Gemini Intelligence特別令人憂心，稱這類代理式AI整合「對隱私日益敵意」，對Signal構成「生存威脅」。
新功能預設阻擋手機截圖存取。當Signal偵測到截圖嘗試或AI助理試圖存取螢幕，用戶會收到彈出視窗，可選擇是否關閉封鎖，實際形式因裝置而異。
《路透社》本週稍早披露，Meta(META-US)的Muse代理繞過官方Connector工具，利用初始設定取得的系統層級權限，讀取蘋果電腦與Android手機上的Signal訊息。
在macOS上，Muse挪用蘋果為身障用戶設計的輔助使用與截圖工具，對Signal聊天截圖、擷取文字後複製到Muse應用內。蘋果本週更新雖堵住此路徑，但新增的代理權限組仍提供類似能力。
Meta回應《路透社》報導時表示，AI代理需要看到並操作電腦才能代用戶工作，Muse只能透過用戶明確授權的權限存取其他App。蘋果、Google與微軟未立即回應置評請求。
Signal去年已在Windows平台封鎖微軟Recall AI截圖，但表示在macOS上無法可靠提供同類防護；Signal由非營利基金會持有，以端到端加密保護訊息。
Signal主張，開發者應有簡單直接的方式，讓App完全退出AI助理對螢幕讀取、通知與檔案系統的資料處理。
paras_en: Signal announced on the 20th that it will enable a screenshot‑blocking feature by default to prevent AI agents from reading private messages on phones, warning that the tech industry’s trend of embedding AI into consumer devices is eroding privacy protections.
Signal CEO Meredith Whittaker admitted the new protection is still “incomplete” and called on Apple (AAPL‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) to provide more concrete blocking tools.

Signal also demanded that the three companies disclose how their AI agents operate and access data so developers can assess what information the agents have touched and adjust their systems accordingly.

Signal singled out the built‑in Apple Siri AI and Google Gemini Intelligence as particularly concerning, saying such agent‑style AI integrations are becoming “increasingly hostile to privacy” and pose a “survival threat” to Signal.

The new feature defaults to blocking apps from accessing screenshots. When Signal detects a screenshot attempt or an AI assistant trying to read the screen, users see a pop‑up window and can choose whether to lift the block; the exact implementation varies by device.

Reuters earlier this week reported that Meta’s (META‑US) Muse agent bypassed the official Connector tool, using system‑level permissions obtained at setup to read Signal messages on both Apple computers and Android phones.

On macOS, Muse hijacked Apple’s accessibility and screenshot tools designed for users with disabilities, capturing Signal chat screenshots, extracting text, and copying it into the Muse app; Apple’s update this week closed that pathway, but a newly added agent‑permission group still grants similar capabilities.

Meta responded to the Reuters report by saying AI agents need to see and manipulate the computer to act on a user’s behalf, and that Muse can only access other apps through permissions explicitly granted by the user; Apple, Google and Microsoft did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Signal said it blocked Microsoft’s Recall AI screenshot feature on Windows last year, but that it cannot reliably provide the same protection on macOS; Signal is owned by a nonprofit foundation and protects messages with end‑to‑end encryption.
Signal argues that developers should have a simple, direct way to let apps fully opt out of AI assistants reading screens, notifications and file‑system data.

items.title: 黃仁勳離任後 輝達面臨更棘手危機：核心工程師恐遭競爭對手挖角
items.title_en: After Jensen Huang Steps Down, Nvidia Faces a More Tricky Crisis: Core Engineers May Be Poached by Rivals
paras: 輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US)在創辦人黃仁勳遭董事會解除執行長職務後，面臨的危機恐怕不只股價重挫，更深層的隱憂是核心工程師是否會跟著離開。對一家高度仰賴技術創新、並以晶片與軟體整合建立競爭優勢的企業而言，人才流失可能直接牽動未來數年的產品研發與AI布局。
自董事會上週宣布解除黃仁勳職務以來，輝達市值已蒸發約5,000億美元，引發員工、投資人及科技業人士強烈反彈。數千名員工聯署要求黃仁勳復職，部分員工公開批評董事會決定，也已有員工宣布離職。
黃仁勳週二表示，若董事會批准，他將很榮幸重返執行長職位，並提到自己收到員工、投資人、商業夥伴及客戶的大量支持聲音。不過，在公司領導權出現變動後，輝達能否留住打造其技術優勢的核心團隊，已成為投資人更需要關注的問題。
Melius Research首席科技分析師Ben Reitzes在輝達本週財報電話會議前指出，臨時管理團隊最優先的任務之一，就是防止工程師離職。他認為，對長期投資人而言，公司的產品路線圖才是最重要的關鍵，市場需要了解管理層將如何留住人才，確保既有研發計畫不受影響。
這項風險之所以重要，在於輝達的競爭優勢並非只來自單一晶片，而是晶片、軟體及其他技術系統高度整合的產品架構。公司從遊戲顯示卡製造商轉型為AI運算基礎設施核心供應商，仰賴長期技術投資，以及管理層對運算趨勢與市場需求的前瞻判斷。
Circular Technology研究主管Brad Gastwirth指出，若輝達流失5至10名關鍵技術領導者，尤其是負責架構決策或重大產品轉型的人才，就可能造成遠超離職人數本身的衝擊。Synovus投資專業人士Christopher Brown也認為，輝達產品體系高度集中，代表技術人才流失可能使公司的風險同步集中。
對科技企業而言，技術領導者不只是負責現有產品開發，更必須提前數年判斷技術方向，在市場需求尚未完全明朗時，就決定下一代產品的架構與研發路線。黃仁勳過去正是這套體系的重要推動者，他不僅帶領公司轉型，也持續在AI技術商業價值尚未完全確立前投入資源。
黃仁勳離任後，競爭對手可能趁輝達內部動盪展開挖角。Gastwirth預期，超微 (AMD) (AMD-US)、博通 (Broadcom) (AVGO-US)、大型雲端服務商及AI新創企業，都可能積極招募輝達工程師。Brown也認為，競爭對手鎖定輝達技術人才的招募行動幾乎難以避免。
特斯拉 (Tesla) (TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克也曾談及黃仁勳與員工之間的關係。他指出，許多輝達員工是因為黃仁勳而加入公司，並出於對他的忠誠，拒絕其他企業提供的更高薪酬。這也凸顯黃仁勳的影響力不只在企業決策，更深入員工文化與人才凝聚力。
員工的反應同樣反映這種連結。已離職的輝達機器人研究員Darrell Dai在離職聲明中，肯定黃仁勳營造鼓勵工程師探索、承擔風險並從錯誤中學習的工作環境，也讚揚他願意在技術商業價值尚未明朗時就投入資源。輝達研究科學家Shang-Wen Li則在社群平台X公開表示，對董事會的決定深感失望。
面對內部不安，臨時執行長兼財務長Colette Kress已開始透過薪酬措施穩定團隊。她在週三舉行的全員大會宣布，將原定較晚時間發放的加薪及額外股票獎勵提前至12月，並強調公司的技術路線圖及客戶關係都不會改變。
然而，薪酬能否真正留住核心人才，仍存在疑問。一名參與全員大會的員工表示，更好的待遇短期內確實具有吸引力，但未必足以成為長期留任的理由。過去十年輝達股價大幅上漲，已讓不少資深員工累積可觀財富，部分人甚至擁有相當程度的財務自由，額外股票獎勵的吸引力可能因此下降。
對這些工程師而言，未來技術方向、研發自主權，以及公司是否仍有能力推動創新，可能比短期薪酬更重要。若員工認為原有技術願景與領導文化已經改變，即使公司提高薪資，也未必能完全消除離職意願。
Kress在華爾街具有良好聲譽，但她過去的職涯主要集中在財務管理領域，外界因此關注她能否承擔制定輝達未來十年技術及產品路線圖的重任。董事會目前也正尋找正式執行長，內部及外部人選都在考慮範圍內。
Gastwirth認為，黃仁勳的價值不只是管理公司，而是具備預判運算及AI技術發展方向的能力，並能讓輝達提前數年完成布局。當下一代AI技術逐漸成形，若公司同時失去黃仁勳及其他關鍵技術領導者，未來的產品架構、研發節奏與技術判斷能力都可能受到影響。
因此，輝達眼前真正需要處理的，並不只是尋找下一任執行長，而是如何延續黃仁勳建立的技術文化與創新體系。若核心工程師陸續流向競爭對手，公司失去的將不只是人力，更可能是維持AI技術領先地位所需的專業知識與長期戰略能力。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) faces a crisis that may go beyond a sharp stock price drop after its founder Jensen Huang was removed as CEO by the board; the deeper concern is whether core engineers will follow him out. For a company that relies heavily on technological innovation and builds competitive advantage through chip‑software integration, talent loss could directly affect product development and AI strategy for years to come.

Since the board announced Huang’s removal last week, Nvidia’s market value has evaporated about $500 billion, sparking strong backlash from employees, investors and tech industry observers. Thousands of staff signed a petition demanding Huang’s reinstatement, some publicly criticized the board’s decision, and a number of employees have already resigned.

Huang said on Tuesday that, if the board approves, he would be honored to return as CEO and noted the overwhelming support he has received from employees, investors, business partners and customers. However, with the leadership change, investors are now more focused on whether Nvidia can retain the core team that built its technological edge.

Melius Research chief technology analyst Ben Reitzes told the earnings call this week that one of the interim management team’s top priorities is preventing engineer turnover. He believes that for long‑term investors the company’s product roadmap is the key issue, and the market needs to understand how the new leadership will keep talent and protect existing R&D plans.

The risk matters because Nvidia’s competitive edge does not stem from a single chip but from a highly integrated architecture of chips, software and other technologies. The firm has shifted from a gaming graphics card maker to a core supplier of AI compute infrastructure, relying on long‑term tech investment and forward‑looking judgments about compute trends and market demand.

Circular Technology research lead Brad Gastwirth warned that losing just five to ten key technical leaders—especially those responsible for architecture decisions or major product transitions—could have impacts far greater than the headcount loss itself. Synovus investment professional Christopher Brown added that Nvidia’s product ecosystem is highly concentrated, meaning talent loss could concentrate risk as well.

For tech companies, technical leaders are not only responsible for current product development but must also forecast technology directions years in advance, deciding on next‑generation architectures and R&D paths before market demand is fully clear. Huang has been a driving force of this system, leading the transformation and investing in AI technology even before its commercial value was fully proven.

After Huang’s departure, rivals may seize the internal turmoil to poach Nvidia staff. Gastwirth expects AMD (AMD-US), Broadcom (AVGO-US), large cloud service providers and AI startups to actively recruit Nvidia engineers. Brown agrees that competitors’ attempts to hire Nvidia’s technical talent are almost inevitable.

Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk also commented on the relationship between Huang and Nvidia employees. He said many staff joined because of Huang and, out of loyalty to him, turned down higher salaries offered by other firms. This underscores Huang’s influence beyond corporate decisions, extending into employee culture and talent cohesion.

The employee response mirrors this bond. Former Nvidia robotics researcher Darrell Dai, in his resignation statement, praised the environment Huang fostered—encouraging engineers to explore, take risks and learn from mistakes—and lauded his willingness to fund projects before their commercial value was clear. Nvidia research scientist Shang‑Wen Li posted on X expressing deep disappointment with the board’s decision.

Facing internal unease, interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress has begun using compensation measures to steady the team. At a company‑wide meeting on Wednesday she announced that salary increases and additional stock awards originally slated for a later date will be moved up to December, and she stressed that the technical roadmap and customer relationships will remain unchanged.

Nevertheless, doubts remain about whether compensation alone can retain core talent. An employee who attended the all‑hands said better pay is attractive in the short term but may not be enough for long‑term retention. Over the past decade Nvidia’s soaring stock price has given many senior staff substantial wealth and even financial independence, reducing the lure of extra stock grants.

For these engineers, future technology direction, R&D autonomy and the company’s ability to keep innovating may matter more than short‑term pay. If staff feel the original technical vision and leadership culture have shifted, higher salaries may not fully erase their desire to leave.

Kress enjoys a strong reputation on Wall Street, but her career has been focused on financial management, prompting questions about her capacity to shape Nvidia’s ten‑year technical and product roadmap. The board is also searching for a permanent CEO, considering both internal and external candidates.

Gastwirth argues that Huang’s value lies not just in running the company but in anticipating compute and AI trends and enabling Nvidia to lay out its roadmap years ahead. As the next generation of AI technology takes shape, losing both Huang and other key technical leaders could affect product architecture, development pace and technical judgment.

Thus, Nvidia’s immediate challenge is not merely finding a new CEO but preserving the technology culture and innovation system Huang built. If core engineers gradually move to rivals, the loss will be more than manpower—it could erode the specialized knowledge and long‑term strategic capability needed to maintain AI leadership.

items.title: 花旗內控出大包！少算350億美元風險資產 被迫注資補強
items.title_en: Citigroup Faces Major Internal Control Failure: Underestimated $35 Billion in Risk‑Weighted Assets Forces Capital Injection
paras: 花旗集團(C-US)再傳風險管理疏失。《路透》近日報導，知情人士透露，花旗因歐洲交易部門部分交易記錄錯誤，低估約350億美元的風險加權資產(RWA)，迫使銀行向相關子公司注資，以恢復資本緩衝。這起事件為花旗爭取解除監管限制的努力增添變數，也讓執行長佛瑞塞(Jane Fraser)多年來推動的整頓工作再受考驗。
兩名知情人士表示，問題涉及花旗英國證券部門的部分交易。該部門使用以自行設定的統計假設為基礎的內部模型，衡量相關資產風險，但監管機關並未核准該模型用於這類交易。當銀行改以標準風險模型重新評估後，風險加權資產規模隨之大幅增加。
其中一名知情人士指出，低估金額約為350億美元。風險加權資產是監管機關評估銀行應持有多少資本、以吸收潛在損失的重要依據，因此低估這項數據，可能使銀行原先計算的資本緩衝高於實際水準。這筆350億美元代表風險加權資產的低估規模，並非花旗的實際虧損或注資金額。
花旗表示，已於今年夏季發現並解決歐洲交易子公司的內部資本模型問題。
花旗聲明指出：「該子公司自始至終均完全符合監管最低要求，控股公司及主要營運銀行均未受到影響。」
銀行並表示：「花旗已完成補救措施，並注入資本，立即恢復該子公司的資本緩衝。」
不過，《路透》無法確認花旗是否已在對外公布的財務數據中，反映這次風險加權資產調整。
申報文件顯示，這家美國第三大銀行今年6月及9月公布的風險加權資產總額約為1.2兆美元。
負責英國金融業監管的英國央行表示，不評論個別企業；英國金融行為監理總署(FCA)則未回應置評要求。
美國聯準會對這次低估事件不予置評，美國貨幣監理署(OCC)則未能在非辦公時間立即取得回應。
整頓內控多年，解除監管限制再添變數
花旗近年持續受到美國監管機關嚴格監督。花旗截至今年夏季仍以年內向監管機關提交文件、爭取解除限制為目標，如今再傳交易與資本模型問題，使整頓成效重新受到檢視。
富國銀行分析師 Mike Mayo領導的團隊在客戶報告中指出，這項錯誤從監管角度來看並不重大，但花旗過去已有多次疏失，外界對其要求也更高。
分析師寫道：「觀感並不好，因為花旗先前犯過錯，外界對它的標準更高。」不過，團隊也強調：「花旗搞砸了，但銀行的標準不應是零失誤。」
花旗的監管問題可追溯至2020年，當時聯準會與貨幣監理署要求銀行改善長期存在的風險管理及資料治理缺失。花旗遭罰4億美元，並同意處理一系列積弊，但因改善資料管理問題的進度落後，2024年又遭罰1.36億美元。
分析師認為，若能解除監管限制，花旗將可釋出資源，成為佛瑞塞任內的重要成果，並有助支撐股價。
花旗在歐洲也曾因內控問題受罰。2024年，英國監管機關因其交易業務控管失靈，開罰相當於7,850萬美元，為當地針對系統控管缺失所開出的重大罰單之一。相關疏失包括花旗在2022年5月引發歐洲股市突然下挫的交易事件。
此外，英國央行旗下審慎監理總署(PRA)也曾於2019年，因花旗提供不正確的財務報表，對其開罰5,630萬美元。
paras_en: Citigroup (C-US) is again reported to have a risk‑management lapse. Reuters recently reported that insiders say the bank underestimated about $35 billion of risk‑weighted assets (RWA) due to errors in some European trading‑desk records, forcing the bank to inject capital into the relevant subsidiary to restore its capital buffer. The episode adds uncertainty to Citigroup’s effort to lift regulatory restrictions and puts CEO Jane Fraser’s multi‑year remediation program under further strain.

Two insiders said the problem involves certain trades in Citigroup’s UK securities division. That unit used an internal model based on self‑set statistical assumptions to measure asset risk, but regulators had not approved the model for those trades. When the bank switched to the standard risk model for a re‑assessment, the RWA figure jumped sharply.

One insider noted the under‑estimation amounted to roughly $35 billion. RWA is a key metric regulators use to determine how much capital a bank must hold to absorb potential losses, so under‑reporting it could make the bank’s calculated capital buffer appear higher than it actually is. The $35 billion reflects the size of the RWA shortfall, not an actual loss or capital injection by Citigroup.
Citigroup said it discovered and resolved the internal capital model issue at its European trading subsidiary earlier this summer.
The bank’s statement said: “The subsidiary has consistently met all regulatory minimum requirements, and neither the holding company nor the primary operating bank has been affected.”
The bank added: “Citigroup has completed remedial actions and injected capital, immediately restoring the subsidiary’s capital buffer.”
However, Reuters could not verify whether Citigroup has reflected the RWA adjustment in its publicly disclosed financial data.
Regulatory filings show that the U.S. bank, the third‑largest in the country, reported total RWA of about $1.2 trillion in June and September of this year.
The Bank of England, which oversees UK financial regulation, declined to comment on individual firms; the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) did not respond to requests for comment.
The Federal Reserve declined to comment on the under‑estimation, and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) was not immediately reachable outside of office hours.
Years of internal‑control overhaul now face another variable as the bank seeks to lift regulatory constraints.

Citigroup has been under intense scrutiny from U.S. regulators in recent years. Up to this summer the bank continued to file documents with regulators and pursue the removal of restrictions; the resurfacing of trading and capital‑model issues now puts the effectiveness of its remediation back under the microscope.

Wells Fargo analyst Mike Mayo’s team noted in a client report that, from a regulatory standpoint, the error is not material, but Citigroup’s history of missteps has raised expectations from the market.

The analysts wrote: “The perception is poor because Citigroup has slipped before, so the bar is set higher for it.” They added, however, “Citigroup messed up, but the standard for a bank should not be zero errors.”

Citigroup’s regulatory troubles date back to 2020, when the Fed and OCC demanded improvements to longstanding risk‑management and data‑governance deficiencies. The bank was fined $400 million and agreed to address a series of issues, but lagging progress on data‑management fixes led to another $136 million penalty in 2024.
Analysts believe that if the regulatory constraints are lifted, Citigroup could free up resources, making it a flagship achievement of Fraser’s tenure and potentially supporting the stock price.

Citigroup has also been fined in Europe for internal‑control failures. In 2024, UK regulators penalised the bank $78.5 million for trading‑business control breakdowns, one of the larger fines for systemic control lapses in the region, including a trade‑induced sharp drop in European equities in May 2022.
In addition, the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) of the Bank of England fined Citigroup $56.3 million in 2019 for providing inaccurate financial statements.

items.title_en: Reuters: SEC Probes Nvidia's Accounting Practices; Singapore Revenue Disclosure and AI Circular Financing Under Scrutiny
paras: 《路透》週五 (20 日) 報導，兩名知情人士透露，美國證券交易委員會 (SEC) 正調查輝達 (NVDA-US) 的會計處理，執法人員正在檢視公司可能涉及的會計問題。這項調查讓近期深陷前執行長黃仁勳私生活風波、晶片出口管制與反壟斷調查的輝達，再添監管壓力。
《華爾街日報》週二已披露 SEC 正在調查輝達，但當時未能確認調查重點。《路透》此次首度指出，會計問題是調查焦點之一，不過目前仍無法確認調查何時啟動，以及 SEC 究竟正在檢視哪些會計事項。
SEC 發言人拒絕評論，輝達發言人則未立即回應置評要求。目前調查尚未有結論，受到調查不代表公司已被認定違法，許多案件最終也未導致執法處分。
新加坡營收揭露方式改變 再度受到關注
在輝達面臨更廣泛審視之際，公司去年調整地區營收揭露方式的決定，也重新受到關注。
輝達去年將地區營收的分類依據，由客戶的帳單地址改為客戶總部所在地，並表示這樣能更準確反映營收的地理分布。調整後，新加坡不再單獨列於地區營收明細。
《金融時報》週二引述公司帳目報導，輝達做出這項變更之際，歸於新加坡的銷售額已攀升至接近全球營收的一半。隨著黃仁勳與黃樂 (Alice Huang) 的關係曝光，這項揭露方式的改變再次受到媒體檢視。
不過，目前尚無法確認，新加坡營收揭露方式是否屬於 SEC 此次調查的具體範圍。
AI循環融資引疑慮 投資人關注營收品質與財務曝險
除了地區營收揭露，分析師與投資人也愈來愈關注 AI 產業的循環融資安排。
包括輝達在內的晶片業者，透過複雜的財務安排，協助客戶籌措購買晶片、興建資料中心等昂貴 AI 基礎設施所需的資金。輝達曾投資 AI 公司與雲端服務供應商，也曾為採用其設備的資料中心專案提供相關擔保。
這類安排使晶片供應商同時扮演投資者或資金支持者的角色，而獲得支持的企業又向其購買設備。批評人士認為，這可能增加投資人判斷晶片業者營收品質，以及實際承擔多少財務風險的難度。
SEC 執法主管 David Woodcock 上月接受《路透》訪問時表示，該機構正檢視 AI 企業的公司資訊揭露，以確認企業是否充分向投資人說明潛在風險。不過，這項說法並未具體指向輝達，也未證實循環融資就是此次調查的標的。
輝達代理執行長、原財務長克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 在週二法說會上表示，公司對自身支持 AI 產業發展的角色感到自豪，但未來參與 AI 產業融資交易時，將採取更嚴格的篩選標準。
黃仁勳風波延燒 Megaspeed涉晶片出口調查
會計調查曝光之際，輝達投資人仍在消化黃仁勳遭撤換，以及他與包括黃樂在內的對象發生婚外情所帶來的衝擊。美國當局懷疑黃樂是中國間諜，中國則否認這項指控。
知情人士先前表示，黃樂曾領導新加坡企業 Megaspeed，該公司過去是輝達的重要晶片客戶。美國司法部與商務部本週表示，自 2024 年起便開始調查 Megaspeed，釐清其是否涉及將輝達 AI 晶片運往中國、違反出口管制。
Megaspeed 表示，黃樂已於 2025 年 8 月離職，並強調公司從事的是「合法業務」。《路透》未能聯繫上黃樂取得回應。
黃仁勳則在 11 月 8 日發布聲明承認婚外情，但未在聲明中點名對象。
自拜登政府以可能強化中國軍事能力為由，禁止先進 AI 晶片出口至中國後，東南亞已成為晶片走私至中國的重要轉運地區。相關爭議也促使華府出現更多聲音，要求加強因應北京帶來的科技安全威脅。
司法部另查併購與競爭行為 SEC強調會計執法
SEC 調查只是輝達目前面臨的法律問題之一。《路透》上月報導，美國司法部也在審查輝達以 129 億美元收購開源平台 Hugging Face 的交易，並對其併購活動與商業行為展開更廣泛的反壟斷調查。
在監管方向上，川普政府任內的 SEC 雖已縮減部分執法行動，但表示將聚焦於傳統證券詐欺，包括長期以來一直是執法核心的會計違規。
SEC 最近也在執法部門內成立新的財務報導與會計單位，專責推進會計及審計領域的案件。輝達此次受到調查的具體會計事項與範圍，仍待進一步釐清。
輝達 (NVDA-US) 股價週五 (20 日) 暴跌 14.01%，收每股 125.53 美元，連續第七個交易日收黑，週線也連續第七週下跌，創 2008 年金融海嘯以來最長連跌紀錄。
paras_en: Reuters reported on Friday (the 20th) that two insiders said the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is investigating Nvidia's (NVDA-US) accounting practices, with enforcement staff reviewing possible accounting issues at the company. The probe adds regulatory pressure to Nvidia, which is already dealing with former CEO Jensen Huang's personal scandal, chip export controls and antitrust investigations.

The Wall Street Journal disclosed on Tuesday that the SEC is investigating Nvidia, but at the time could not confirm the focus of the investigation. Reuters now says accounting issues are one of the focal points, though it is still unclear when the inquiry began or exactly which accounting matters the SEC is examining.

An SEC spokesperson declined to comment, and a Nvidia spokesperson did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The investigation has not reached a conclusion; being investigated does not mean the company has been found to have broken the law, and many cases ultimately do not result in enforcement action.
Change in Singapore revenue disclosure draws renewed attention
As Nvidia faces broader scrutiny, its decision last year to change the way it reports regional revenue has come back into focus.

Last year Nvidia shifted the basis for regional revenue classification from the customer's billing address to the location of the customer's headquarters, saying this better reflects the geographic distribution of its sales. After the change, Singapore was no longer listed as a separate line item in regional revenue details.

The Financial Times cited company filings on Tuesday, noting that when Nvidia made the change, sales attributed to Singapore had risen to almost half of total global revenue. With Jensen Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang coming to light, the change in disclosure is again under media examination.
However, it is not yet clear whether the Singapore revenue disclosure method falls within the specific scope of the SEC’s current investigation.
AI circular financing raises concerns; investors focus on revenue quality and financial exposure
Beyond regional revenue disclosure, analysts and investors are increasingly watching the circular financing arrangements in the AI industry.

Chip makers, including Nvidia, use complex financial structures to help customers raise money for buying chips, building data centers and other costly AI infrastructure. Nvidia has invested in AI firms and cloud service providers, and has also provided guarantees for data‑center projects that use its equipment.

These arrangements cause chip suppliers to act as investors or financiers, while the supported companies purchase equipment from them. Critics say this can make it harder for investors to assess the quality of chip makers’ revenue and how much financial risk they actually bear.

SEC enforcement chief David Woodcock told Reuters last month that the agency is reviewing corporate disclosures by AI companies to ensure they adequately explain potential risks to investors. The comment was not directed specifically at Nvidia, nor does it confirm that circular financing is a target of the current probe.

Nvidia’s acting CEO and former CFO Colette Kress said at Tuesday’s earnings call that the company is proud of its role in supporting AI industry development, but will apply stricter screening standards when participating in AI financing transactions in the future.
Jensen Huang scandal intensifies; Megaspeed faces chip export probe

As the accounting probe emerges, Nvidia investors are still digesting the fallout from Jensen Huang’s ouster and his alleged extramarital affair with Alice Huang. U.S. authorities suspect Alice Huang of being a Chinese spy, a claim China denies.

Insiders previously said Alice Huang led Singapore‑based Megaspeed, a former major Nvidia chip customer. The U.S. Justice Department and Commerce Department said this week that they have been investigating Megaspeed since 2024 to determine whether it helped ship Nvidia AI chips to China in violation of export controls.
Megaspeed said Alice Huang left the company in August 2025 and stressed that the firm conducts “legal business.” Reuters was unable to reach Alice Huang for comment.
Jensen Huang issued a statement on November 8 acknowledging an extramarital affair, but did not name the other party.

Since the Biden administration banned advanced AI chip exports to China on national‑security grounds, Southeast Asia has become a key transshipment hub for chips smuggled into China. The controversy has spurred more calls in Washington for stronger measures against the technology‑security threats posed by Beijing.
Justice Department also probes mergers and competition; SEC stresses accounting enforcement

The SEC investigation is just one of the legal challenges Nvidia currently faces. Reuters reported last month that the U.S. Justice Department is also reviewing Nvidia’s $12.9 billion acquisition of the open‑source platform Hugging Face, and has launched a broader antitrust probe into its merger activity and business practices.

Under the current regulatory climate, the SEC, which trimmed some enforcement actions during the Trump administration, says it will focus on traditional securities fraud, including long‑standing core enforcement areas such as accounting violations.

The SEC has recently created a new financial reporting and accounting unit within its enforcement division to advance cases in the accounting and audit space. The specific accounting issues and scope of Nvidia’s investigation remain to be clarified.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) shares plunged 14.01% on Friday (the 20th) to $125.53, marking a seventh consecutive day of losses and a seventh straight week down, the longest losing streak since the 2008 financial crisis.
